title: 軌旁落石與異物偵測
summary: 軌旁落石與異物偵測以「異物偵測覆蓋延遲與誤報漏報」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。軌旁異物偵測要把感測範圍、事件判定與列車防護動作連接，警報延遲和漏檢比漂亮影像更重要，正常訊號不能直接視為安全許可。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops obstruction coverage latency false alarms and missed events through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Trackside obstruction detection connects sensing coverage, event decisions and train protection; latency and missed events matter more than attractive images, and a normal signal is not automatically movement permission. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

Boundary: Vertical fall without initial speed or drag; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. stages.title: 落體到達時間與警報總延遲
stages.titleEn: Falling-object arrival time & Total alarm latency
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「落體到達時間」與「警報總延遲」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 落體到達時間：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「落體到達時間」如何影響軌旁落石與異物偵測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Falling-object arrival time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Trackside rockfall and obstruction detection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 理想自由落體時間只是事件時間尺度。本模型把 h 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 2.11783 s。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。無初速無阻力垂落。使用合成物體軌跡作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；碰撞反彈與坡面滑動改變到達時間，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「落體到達時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ideal free-fall time is only an event timescale. In this model, h is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 2.11783 s. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Vertical fall without initial speed or drag. Use synthetic object trajectory as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Bounces and slope sliding alter arrival time; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Falling-object arrival time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 落體到達時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Falling-object arrival time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「落體到達時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Falling-object arrival time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：h=20 m, g=9.81 m/s2；y=sqrt(2*h/g)=2.01928 s。只把 h 增加百分之十，y=2.11783 s。模型邊界：無初速無阻力垂落；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: h=20 m, g=9.81 m/s2; y=sqrt(2*h/g)=2.01928 s. Increasing only h with a ten-percent increase gives y=2.11783 s. Boundary: Vertical fall without initial speed or drag; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Falling-object arrival time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以合成物體軌跡區分模型與觀察，先用合成高速影格與時鐘建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「落體到達時間」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use synthetic object trajectory to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic high-speed frames and clock, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Falling-object arrival time. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Bounces and slope sliding alter arrival time. Explain which evidence in synthetic object trajectory distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：碰撞反彈與坡面滑動改變到達時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
